iterations.detail: The initial run was stopped and cleanly restarted after fixing exact-start evaluation and the incorrect substep-time assertion. A brief restart was also stopped to ensure only one CPU process and one clean final log. Original temporary log was overwritten; these summaries are retained explicitly, not labelled passing runs.

Pre-release-guard diagnostics at 600 simulation seconds recorded 321 still re-launches; 13 had instantaneous speed >40, including 2 with no nearby solid contacts. Old 3-second history could remain small after a ball had already left its support. Added a current-speed guard to still detection, preserving the 3-second window and independent fast local-loop detection.

iterations.result: REPRODUCED DEFAULT GEOMETRY BUG, THEN FIXED

Targeted suite before correction had 13 PASS/3 FAIL, including real non-overlapping left and right corridor balls failing to output within1.2 simulated seconds. Kept15 indices, row heights and custom coordinates; moved lower preset columns to102/194/286/378 with ±4 stagger. After fix minimum wall clearance76, interpeg80; real left/right balls output full16384 at0.6583/0.6917 simulated seconds without unsticking.
